actions.body: Dear Mr Vale, following my email of 18 August, we have not yet had an expected completion date or confirmation of the pest works at 14 Mosswold Crescent. The tenant reports that pest control made its final visit on 7 September, but the contractor expected on 8 September to seal the openings did not attend, and the openings are still reported as unsealed. Could you please tell us: (1) which contractor is doing the proofing, (2) the scope (under-sink openings and/or the wall area), and (3) the date they will attend? The tenant has said a phone call is easiest for access. If you would prefer Northbridge Lettings to arrange the proofing, please say so and we will request a quote for your approval. Kind regards, Tara Wren, Northbridge Lettings
